activities.name: Grocery Challenge
activities.blurb: Buy everything on the list without going over budget. Compare brands, sizes (unit prices) and coupons.
activities.entryBlurb: Buy everything on your list and stay under budget! Pick the cheaper one when you can.

activities.name: Is It Really a Deal?
activities.blurb: Percent-off sales, stacked coupons, BOGO offers and fake 'original prices'. Find the true best deal.
activities.entryBlurb: Which price is lower after the sale?

activities.name: Change Counter
activities.blurb: Customers pay, you make change. Beat the clock, fewest coins earns a bonus.

activities.name: Exchange Booths
activities.blurb: Convert currencies and compare booths with different rates, flat fees and percentage commissions.
activities.entryBlurb: Trade your dollars for pounds! How many pounds do you get?

activities.name: Rent or Buy?
activities.blurb: For each family, simulate renting vs. buying over their time horizon, rent growth, mortgage, upkeep, taxes, appreciation and the investment return on the down payment.
activities.entryBlurb: Help families decide: rent a home or buy one?

activities.name: Budget Planner
activities.blurb: Build a 50/30/20 budget from a real paycheck, then live through 6 months of surprise expenses.
activities.entryBlurb: Make a money plan, then see what happens when surprises pop up!

activities.name: Save · Spend · Share
activities.blurb: Split your earnings into three jars.

activities.name: Market Quiz
activities.blurb: Questions about budgets, prices, deals and currencies.
